integrity: Analytical proof plus an independently formulated exact rational finite check; finite cases alone do not prove the continuum of parameter values. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only right triangles h>=2 and nonconstant odd primitive periods >=3 are classified. Ties are fixed. Even cycles, fixed points, global basins and h<2 are excluded; bibliographic equivalents may exist.
title: Odd-period rigidity and an interlaced bifurcation staircase for right-triangle farthest projections
